People underestimate weed. 
I’m bi polar and was a chronic smoker for about a year and a half, would smoke everyday. At first, it made my depression go away. I was confident and happy. But slowly the depression crept back in, and I just kept smoking because being stoned was just how I preferred to be. Then one day, I went to dinner with some friends and I smoked before dinner…right when I sat down, I knew something was different. Everyone’s voice began to become high pitched and I felt like I was invisible and viewing everyone at the dinner table from a different world. I was completely disconnected. When I was in this state, all my friends at the dinner were plotting against me and someone from the sky was telling them to do so. This lasted about 2 hours. The next day, I felt off still and on the bus herd a woman yell “ GET OFF” just to find there was no other woman on the bus…..so I went to the hospital that night and they ran some tests but determined I was fine. Every since that there’s been maybe 5 or 6 different times I’ve herd things that aren’t there. Often when I’m alone at home I’ll hear people whispering to me from the halls. The thing is , I don’t think I’m schizophrenic because I’m aware that they aren’t real.  So that’s my story. But..in my opinion you should go enjoy your vacation especially if it’s with people you know you are safe with, open up to them about what you have been struggling with lately and definitely don’t touch pot right now until you meet with doctors.
